IDP

We welcome computer science students to complete their IDP or Application Project at our chair.

Contact person: Lino Ballof (l.ballof@tum.de)

 

Application process:

  1. Select a topic from the list of open topics below. If no topics are listed, we are currently not offering any new IDPs. In this case you can either wait until new topics are announced or apply with your own topic proposal.
  2. If you have chosen to complete your IDP on one of the provided topics, kindly send your CV and your transcript of records as separate files to l.ballof@tum.de.
  3. We evaluate your application and check whether you fit our qualification profile. Please wait until your potential supervisor confirms your registration. If we receive more than one suitable application on the same topic at the same time, we will assign the IDP according to the first-come-first-serve principle.
  4. After receiving an acceptance email from your supervisor, you will discuss all further details regarding content and timeline.
